data.long_meaning: Alishaba is a name of Arabic origin which means 'Noble, Free'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'sh-b-r' which symbolizes freedom and nobility. Parents who choose alishaba usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
